info.title: RequestPort REST API
info.description:
The agent API at `/api/v1`. Generated by `scripts/generate-openapi.mjs` from `packages/domain/src/transport-metadata.ts`; do not edit it by hand.

Request schemas are each command's own input schema, less the fields the route writes over the caller's input. Checks made in code — zod refinements, and the repositories' own checks — have no JSON Schema form and are not shown.

No response schema is recorded for any operation: a command answers `{ result }` with its own output, and a read answers the repository's rows, and neither declares a schema. The document gives none rather than invent one.

tags.name: Commands
tags.description: POST /api/v1/commands/{name}, each with a JSON envelope.

get.description: Any authenticated agent credential bound to a project, and any operator credential, reaches this; it needs no scope. An operator is answered from its own credential: its organisation, its project or none, and its scopes.

agentBearer.description: An agent credential, sent as `Authorization: Bearer …`. Browser cookies are not accepted. The scopes an operation lists are the ones the credential must hold.

operatorBearer.description: An operator credential: an `rpo_` key a person issues for a script, a CI job or the self-host CLI, sent as `Authorization: Bearer …`. It acts with the live authority of the member who issued it, narrowed by its scopes and, if the issuer chose, to one project. It reaches only the operations that list this scheme, and only while the deployment has operator credentials switched on. The scopes an operation lists are the ones the credential must hold.

alias.description: An alias for the credential's project: 1 to 120 characters after trimming, no control characters or secret-shaped content.

repositoryUrl.description: A GitHub repository as https://github.com/<owner>/<repository>, optionally ending .git, with no query, fragment or credentials.

Status401.description: The credential is missing, invalid or not for this resource.

WWW-Authenticate.description: A Bearer challenge naming the protected-resource metadata for /api/v1.

Status403.description: The credential lacks a scope, role or binding the operation requires, or is bound to no project where one is required.

Status404.description: No such command, path or tenant-scoped resource.

Status409.description: The operation conflicts with current state, the expected version or an earlier use of the idempotency key, or the routing policy denies it.

Status413.description: The request body is over the route's size limit.

Status415.description: The request is not Content-Type: application/json.

Status422.description: The body, the envelope, the input or a query parameter is invalid.

Retry-After.description: Sent when the limiter reports a delay, as that number; details.retryAfterSeconds carries it raised to a whole second, at least one.

Status500.description: The operation failed for a reason the route does not name.
